Are you sure you want the app to reset macOS display settings? The system will reboot after the reset.
Clearing NVRAM also removes low-level firmware preferences, such as startup disk and boot-related settings. macOS will recreate or reset them as appropriate after restart.

¿Seguro que quieres que la app restablezca la configuración de pantalla de macOS? El sistema se reiniciará después del restablecimiento.

trans-unit.id: Extended luminance range and 16-bpc for greater color accuracy (default is 8-bpc, SDR). With an HDR compatible Color Profile (`Display P3` recommended), HDR content is preserved when mirroring to an HDR/EDR display. trans-unit.source: Extended luminance range and 16-bpc for greater color accuracy (default is 8-bpc, SDR). With an HDR compatible Color Profile (`Display P3` recommended), HDR content is preserved when mirroring to an HDR/EDR display. Full screen stream and PIP window with both `Video Filters` and `HDR Filter Pipeline` enabled show proper HDR content or can be manually tone-mapped using an appropriate `Exposure` filter to differentiate HDR luminances up to virtual 10.000 nits.
trans-unit.target: Rango de luminancia extendido y 16 bpc para mayor precisión de color (por defecto, 8 bpc y SDR). Con un perfil de color compatible con HDR (se recomienda `Display P3`), el contenido HDR se conserva al duplicar en una pantalla HDR/EDR. La transmisión en pantalla completa y la ventana PIP con `Filtros de vídeo` y `Procesamiento de filtro HDR` activados muestran correctamente el contenido HDR. También puedes ajustar manualmente su mapeo de tonos con un filtro de `Exposición` adecuado para distinguir luminancias HDR de hasta 10.000 nits virtuales.
trans-unit.note: 53454 - Help for the virtual screen HDR and 16-bit color setting. Backticked Video Filters, HDR Filter Pipeline and Exposure refer to localized UI controls; Display P3 is a color profile name.

trans-unit.id: The app will apply the loaded EDID when this display is connected. The operation causes the screen to flicker and switch modes if the existing mode is not available with the updated EDID. If the new EDID has different id data (vendor, model, serial), the display will be redetected as a different one. Hold ⇧ Shift on startup to enable safe mode and avoid auto-apply. Physically reconnect display to revert back to the original in case of serious trouble.
trans-unit.source: The app will apply the loaded EDID when this display is connected. The operation causes the screen to flicker and switch modes if the existing mode is not available with the updated EDID. If the new EDID has different id data (vendor, model, serial), the display will be redetected as a different one. Hold ⇧ Shift on startup to enable safe mode and avoid auto-apply. Physically reconnect display to revert back to the original in case of serious trouble.
trans-unit.target: La aplicación aplicará el EDID cargado al conectar esta pantalla. La operación hace que la pantalla parpadee y cambie de modo si el actual no está disponible con el EDID actualizado. Si el nuevo EDID tiene otros identificadores (fabricante, modelo o número de serie), la pantalla se detectará como una distinta. trans-unit.source: This can be a result of disabled DDC/CI support (check the display's OSD), display firmware limitations or connection issues. trans-unit.id: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. With extended it also uses product name, alphanumeric serial number, and production date. With port and location the app also considers hardware connectivity data.
trans-unit.source: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. With extended it also uses product name, alphanumeric serial number, and production date. With port and location the app also considers hardware connectivity data.
trans-unit.target: Configura cómo se relacionan los datos de esta pantalla con una pantalla detectada durante la configuración o detección. Cambiar esta opción puede hacer que una pantalla se reconozca como nueva y quede desvinculada de su configuración guardada. La coincidencia por UUID del sistema usa la identificación predeterminada de macOS. Con identificadores básicos, la aplicación usa los ID de fabricante y modelo y el número de serie. Con los extendidos, también usa el nombre del producto, el número de serie alfanumérico y la fecha de fabricación. Con puerto y ubicación, también considera los datos de conexión del hardware.

trans-unit.id: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.source: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Cuando la amplificación HDR está activada y el control de brillo por hardware está desactivado, la aplicación usa una escala continua entre cero y el máximo de amplificación calibrado. Por ello, el nivel neutro (100⁠% de brillo, cuando el contenido HDR no se recorta) puede no coincidir con el límite de un segmento del OSD y resultar difícil de alcanzar con los atajos de teclado. Para resolverlo, se inserta un paso intermedio adicional al 100⁠% de brillo.
trans-unit.note: 50000 - Neutral software HDR brightness keyboard step setting help.
